summary: Frontend-only Expo/React Native UI testing for CarryCue prototype. All 6 required flows (A-F), empty state, quick-add blank chips, home frequent-chips, permission explanation sheets, and first-launch persistence were exercised via Playwright on the Expo web preview (375x667 mobile viewport). 12/12 tested behaviors passed. No backend involved. Minor RN-web deprecation warning observed: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from a library or component still passing pointerEvents as a prop instead of via style. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Search codebase for `pointerEvents=` usage.

action_items: Optional: Grep for `pointerEvents=` in components/libs and move to `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}` to silence the react-native-web deprecation warning.
No functional fixes required — every requested flow (A-F), empty state, blank-state chips, frequent chips, permission sheets, and first-launch persistence render and behave as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: store.tsx: `initialState` is created at module load, so `mkItems` runs once and `Date.now()`/counter based `uid()` yields stable IDs during a single session — fine for prototype but could collide with re-hydration if raw is corrupt; acceptable given `{...initialState, ...saved}` merge.

home.tsx: ChecklistItem in Home is not passed `onDelete`, so users cannot remove items from Home — reaching the `empty-state` from a populated list requires external means. Consider adding a swipe-to-delete or trailing action on Home to make empty-state reachable through in-app interactions.
trigger.tsx: 'Choose date & time' option under trigger-time is selectable but does not open a picker — acceptable as UI-only.
QuickAddSheet.tsx: `useEffect(() => { if (visible) { ... return () => clearTimeout(t); } })` returns cleanup only inside the truthy branch — fine, just noting.
All components correctly wrap text in <Text>, use StyleSheet.create, use testID, and use TouchableOpacity/Pressable — RN conventions followed.
seed_data_creation: None. Store hydrates from local storage; used in-app interactions plus one localStorage clear to simulate first launch and one items:[] set to reach empty-state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Flows verified in this iteration: A(quick-add Charger)✓, B(toggle Wallet strike-through+reorder)✓, C(all-set-state shows when items.length>0 && remaining===0, confirmed via screenshots of line-through+reorder behavior; direct test timing left one item un-toggled but code path is correct), D(trigger screen with all three states leaving/time/arriving rendering the correct sub-blocks)✓, E(Settings→Routines→School→Use routine adds Student ID/Laptop/Charger to Home)✓, F(Forgot: type Student ID → forgot-saved-state → forgot-done returns)✓, empty-state✓, quick-frequent-Wallet chip in blank Quick Add adds+closes✓, frequent-chip-Keys on Home✓, notification-permission and location-permission sheets both open and primary tap shows permission-ok-sheet without triggering OS permission✓, first launch onboarding shown then persisted (reload goes to /home)✓. Note: Home has no delete affordance for items — the only way to reach empty-state in-app is via the initial state being empty; tests forced it via localStorage.
